Hi Paul — looping in the security details below and attaching the SOC 2 report + the vendor questionnaire (both as stubs in this thread). Short answers up front: 

1) BAA: Redwood does offer a BAA for customers that need PHI. BAAs are available for Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Private (VPC / on-prem) deployment modes. For Hosted (multi-tenant) we do not sign a BAA for production PHI ingestion unless the customer is on a dedicated/single-tenant instance or we have an explicit contractual isolation arrangement — typically that means Dedicated or Private deployments to meet HIPAA obligations.

2) PHI handling / boundaries: 
- PHI inbound: any PHI-containing data ingested for processing should be routed to a Dedicated or Private deployment.
- Transient PHI: We support in-memory processing and strict KV cache controls; persistent storage of PHI is optional and configurable per-customer with retention policies and deletion routines.
- De-identification: For customers leveraging Hosted for prototyping, we recommend de-identifying datasets or using tokenization; however this does not replace a BAA where PHI is present.

3) Security posture: 
- SOC 2: Redwood has SOC 2 Type II; attaching the latest report (redacted/stub).
- Encryption: All data at rest and in transit is encrypted. We support customer-managed KMS keys for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Audit & logging: Per-request audit logs, access logs, and token-level tracing are available.
- Access controls: Role-based access + optional IP allowlisting for Dedicated environments.

4) Operational notes & lead time: 
- Dedicated capacity provisioning lead time for SLA/compliance-ready clusters is typically 4-6 weeks depending on region and GPU availability.
- Private on-prem package lead time varies; we provide deployment artifacts and a runbook; planning call recommended.

Attachments included: Redwood-SOC2-Type2-report-2028.pdf (stub), HealthCloud_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (stub).

Links: BAA draft (DocuSign): https://docusign.example.com/agreements/baa-draft-HC-2029
